lines.text: The LORD tells His prophet to raise his voice like a ram's horn and declare to Jacob's house their sins.
On the day of their fast, the people do as they please and oppress all their workers.
The fast God chose is to set the oppressed free, share your bread with the hungry, and clothe the naked.
If they give themselves to the hungry, their night will be like twilight, and they will be like a well-watered garden.
Their people will rebuild the ancient ruins and be called Keeper of the Gate, and God will feed them with the heritage of Jacob.
